resolution: The Aristotle reading concerns determinate signification and an elenctic dialectical method; it is not the occurrence-only PresuppositionLink of the generic performed-denial schema. That schema explicitly assumes its performance-to-episode link and never supplies a semantic or epistemic-to-ontic identity. Norm.Holds expresses a supplied scope/standard policy; an opponent violates it only when the relevant same-sense commitments have been stated. Della Rocca’s explicability argument rejects a proposed state for inexplicability and seeks a principled restriction; its reported dialectical support is not automatically a performative contradiction in every PSR denial. Project self-evident marking is a separate argued closure convention, not a synonym for undemonstrated or intrinsically intelligible. No new such marking is made here.
